plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Development conventions toolkit — Python (py-script/py-project), HTML/CSS/JS (FLOCSS, debug-fab, logging, mock), Next.js 16 App Router (implement/plan), and Markdown. Reference auto-injection via PreToolUse(Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Read) gated by DEV_KIT_PYTHON / DEV_KIT_HTML / DEV_KIT_NEXT / DEV_KIT_MARKDOWN env opt-in; PostToolUse tsc check gated by DEV_KIT_NEXT_TS_CHECK. v4.11.0: add `dev-kit:plugin-config` skill. v4.11.1: remove redundant branch-check step from plugin-migrate.

plugins.name: claude-kit
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring Claude Code instruction files — CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, and skills

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Hook-based project lifecycle management — injects branch context on every prompt, reminds task updates on stop, manages worktrees (toggle via WORK_USE_WORKTREE), and guards force-operations (toggle via WORK_GUARD). Protected branches customizable via WORK_PROTECTED_BRANCHES (comma-separated, default master,main,develop). v2.47.0: branches are named `{type}/{title}` (no PR-number prefix); internal IDs continue in index.yaml for cross-reference only. Section names renamed: 関連PR → 関連ブランチ, 次PR候補 → 次ブランチ候補. v2.48.0: notes-to-claude skill removed (inter-plugin dependency eliminated). v2.49.0: drop NEXT_KIT_TS_CHECK / INJECTION_DISABLE entries from work:plugin-config (managed by /dev-kit:plugin-config or excluded by policy); migrate Step 2 to numbered list. v2.50.0: add WORK_BRANCH_AUTHOR env var to insert author name into branch names ({type}/{author}/{title}). v2.51.0: add WORK_COMMIT_LANG / WORK_COMMIT_TYPE env vars to configure commit message language and type prefix. v2.53.0: redefine notes as a current spec sheet (snapshot — present state only, no history in the body; change recorded only in a trailing 変更履歴 table; no YAML frontmatter); add ノート記述内容ルール reference injected on .work/notes/** edits; remove .work/specs (content merged into notes).

plugins.name: ref-inject
plugins.description: Attaches a reference auto-injection mechanism to a plugin (new or existing). /ref-inject:apply copies a PreToolUse hook that injects edit-path-matched references (required full-body, optional pointer) using a TTL-based per-session YAML token. Also installs a PreToolUse references-edit-guard hook reminding to update _index.yaml / _injection_rules.yaml before editing or creating files under references/. Injection part only — plugin.json/CLAUDE.md/marketplace are plugin-creator's job.
